damage_mechanism: Valve and packing damage, lube oil breakdown
response: Unload the compressor, check the aftercooler fan and belts

damage_mechanism: Overpressure of the mainline toward its MAOP (99 barg)
response: Cut pump speed, check block valve positions

damage_mechanism: Floating roof seal and vent overpressure, vapour release
response: Start the VRU or line up the thermal oxidiser

damage_mechanism: Column separation in the line below 3 barg; receiver overpressure above 12

response: Check oil level and cooler, plan a bearing change
